constraints: Four new worker files only; immutable admission unchanged; no existing workspace/API/BFF/runner/package/lock changes.
Exact I15 TypeScript contracts with injected read/execute/reconcile; no invented HTTP route or direct database access.
Preserve all supplied fields, NULL versus empty, exact decimal strings and source timestamps; lock existing branch/document date.
Complete aggregate up to qualified500 details, explicit changes/removals; no truncation; retained costs read-only and explicit unsupported fields.
Separate Save and SendToWarehouse, send only on fresh unchanged editable readback; create unavailable until qualified numbering. No automatic save-and-send.
Original command/key deep-frozen before dispatch; unknown/malformed response blocks replacement writes; reconcile never redispatches.
Valid confirmed receipt survives failed readback; block further writes until authoritative read; no fabricated row-ID mapping.
Opaque session scope and generation fencing; refresh/selection A-B-A cannot erase unresolved intent, revive stale data or switch credentials.

Actual React mobile synthetic browser tests for decimals/nulls/dates/deltas, duplicated taps, post-save read failure, all outcomes, logout/revocation/selection races; no fake success or skipped browser acceptance.
Memory-only unresolved custody is not durable recovery; report reload/crash recovery limit and retain truthful blocked state.
QR excluded until exact business-field mapping; do not treat arbitrary code as item/serial authorization.
No real camera, security/cert/network changes, deployment or production activation; component completion is not customer-ready end-to-end acceptance.
